scope: New append-only metadata notice client, local journal, synthetic tests; not an activated service

initialRegressions: read must reject a different comment ID
later last-page link without next must not prove completion
apiReviewerAndTestAuthor.final: No pending issues within this test scope. Mocked subprocess tests do not establish real timeout enforcement.

initialFindings: Offset pagination can skip one duplicate notice after deletion of an unrelated earlier comment, falsely permitting acknowledgement.
Claiming before orphan-receipt detection recreated the missing intent, making the second retry succeed.
Pathname checks are not a handle-based sandbox against concurrent directory-to-junction substitution.
Contradictory pagination metadata could be accepted as completion.
Adapter read did not validate the requested comment ID; the core still rejected the mismatch.
disposition: Automatic unknown-ID reconciliation now requires one complete page; any next page stops without a second GET.
Orphan receipt or POST observation is rejected before intent creation, on every attempt.
Trusted stable ancestors are an explicit local-storage assumption; no hostile directory substitution was tested or performed.
Requested comment ID is validated in the adapter and core.
independentReviewer.final: No remaining concrete protocol defect found in the latest reviewed source, including posted.json.
probes: Validated POST IDs persist before GET; restart uses exact-ID GET without POST or LIST.
Corrupt observations, conflicting receipt IDs and orphan entries stop without mutation or network activity.
Incomplete pagination stops after one GET; contradictory links and wrong response IDs are rejected.
independentReviewer.limits: In-memory review probes only. No filesystem writes, directory substitutions, network requests or full-suite run by this reviewer. Retained journal/pins, stable trusted ancestors, operator reconciliation and live worker/provider acceptance remain activation constraints.
